_doc: Type profile: a home (one house, one group of guests, a host who is never contacted). The engine's own strings are written for homes, so it changes none. sections: the sections a guide of this type can have (ids as in content/sections.json); notes: what a guide of this type must hold.
notes: Self check-in, the host is never contacted (no host phone), the house pin offset by about 350 m, one Wi-Fi, a house guide by room.
